decisions.decision: v10.0 milestone: Email & Sync Production Validation with 41 requirements across 6 categories
decisions.rationale: Full audit of all email/emailsync operations against live providers (Gmail, Outlook, IMAP) with real data
Grouped by functional area: sync (3 phases), read (2), write (2), folders (1), infra (2), cross-cutting (1)

decisions.decision: No research phase — validation milestone, not feature milestone
decisions.rationale: Testing existing code, not building new features

decisions.decision: Both automated scripts and manual E2E verification
decisions.rationale: Scripts for reproducibility, manual for edge cases and real browser verification

decisions.decision: Bugs found get fixed in-place within same phase
decisions.rationale: No point deferring fixes when you're actively validating

next_action: Run /gsd:plan-phase 112 to plan Full Sync Validation — write automated validation scripts and verify full sync across Gmail, Outlook, IMAP
